posts.name: Bhuvanya
posts.cooked: i have attended bpt 1 and 2 and have a score of 25 and 75 respectively and i missed bpt 3 so will i be eligible to write oppe?? if i do the bpt 4??

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Read the last line -

image836×578 42.3 KB

Your avg would be 33.33 so you are not eligible as score should be >=40 (avg of 1st three)

posts.name: Bhuvanya
posts.cooked: Ohh…then what should I do?? Do I have to pay the full fee and repeat the course??

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
No, there are different possible options - you can do “repeat OPPE”, if eligible, but to get a good idea go through the doc & check out the table.
